chippenham.snapshot: Chippenham is a Wiltshire market town with full fibre going in and a steady run of telecoms and CCTV work alongside. We kit both routes into that trade. Build contractors and structured-cabling firms running teams across the town hold trade accounts for branded workwear, while sole-trader broadband and CCTV installers order direct online with no account needed, the same lead polo, hi-vis and softshell whichever way they buy.
chippenham.s1_head: Kitting the field engineers of Wiltshire
s1loc: Chippenham sits in the middle of a steady full-fibre build. CityFibre now runs the former Lit Fibre full-fibre network across the town after acquiring it, having added Chippenham to its footprint, while Openreach builds its commercial FTTP across the town and delivers the publicly funded Project Gigabit rollout to the harder-to-reach rural premises around the surrounding villages. Engineers work the streets and cabinets through Monkton Park, Pewsham, Cepen Park, Hardenhuish, Sheldon and out toward Lacock and Calne, so there is a constant flow of poling, ducting and customer-premises connection work across the town.

Alongside the residential rollout sits a solid commercial and industrial scene. Structured-cabling and CCTV firms wire units, offices and yards in Cat5e, Cat6 and fibre across Methuen Park, home to Siemens and Wincanton, the Bumpers Farm Industrial Estate, Greenways Business Park and the newer Southpoint employment site alongside the A350. Siemens also runs its railway signalling factory next to the station. Add the Hathaway Retail Park and the town-centre offices around the Borough Parade and it is steady data-cabling, access-control and camera work for businesses across Chippenham.
